dx_raw:
DIAGNOSOP: Progressive supranuclear palsy, Richardson syndrome variant

Progressive supranuclear palsy (tauopathy), atypical presentation with severe multidirectional nystagmus and early dysarthria

Alternative 1: Cerebellopeduncular syndrome causing severe gaze-evoked nystagmus and ataxic dysarthria
Alternative 2: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 2 (SCA2) presenting with severe ophthalmoplegia/nystagmus and dysarthria
Alternative 3: Late-onset Tay-Sachs disease with bulbar and oculomotor involvement
